initialization.type: fresh model and fresh 32D dictionary, not 16D checkpoint resume
initialization.basis: top32 of same train512 sensitivity data used for current top16 initialization
initialization.mean_and_kmeans: all same 8688 clean train faces; 8192 centers in 32 dimensions

data.selection: all five visible, face_occluded=false, inside canonical crop

artificial_mask_plan.area: pixel mask intersection / GT ellipse area
artificial_mask_plan.sampling: stratified within-bin targets; exact per-face five bins; balanced shape-position slots
artificial_mask_plan.mask: opaque; patch g is ANY occluded RGB pixel, no face-support threshold
artificial_mask_plan.fit: epoch-specific seed; regenerate RGB and DINO features
artificial_mask_plan.shape_method: signed-distance silhouette level sets calibrated to actual ellipse intersection
artificial_mask_plan.shape_limit: high-coverage dilation can merge components; actual topology and coverage are recorded

DINO_and_head.load_scope: full current baseline DINO and trained keypoint head, both frozen; identical to E16 control

trainable: complete recovery including encoder/decoder/spatial correction; dictionary EMA only
g: fixed artificial binary teacher mask; no learned g

loss.position: same primary GT coordinate loss and coefficient as reference plan

comparison.matched_exposure: also preserve validation-selected best-so-far and latest at epoch66 for comparison with interrupted E16; final convergence result separately labeled
comparison.test: same images and fixed five-bin masks; point-size and high-occlusion breakdown

failure_policy: stop; no threshold relaxation or automatic quality retry
implementation_status: new runner/model/cache namespace required before gate
